fields.description:
Three evaluate() paths in the MCP<->library parity gate ship untested. Raised as non-blocking
advisories by the LLM code review on Gerrit 2503 and deferred there; filed here rather than dropped.

## Scope

Add pure-function regression coverage against the already-injectable
`evaluate(live, manifest)` behavior in `scripts/check_mcp_library_parity.py`.
No production behavior change is intended.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] A test proves a declared divergence whose MCP and library surfaces have
  since converged is reported as a stale divergence failure by
  `_check_divergences` through `evaluate(live, manifest)`. Done in Gerrit 2734.
- [x] A test proves `merge_declarations`/`--update` carry existing divergence
  reasons forward and write an empty-reason stub for a newly-diverging tool, so
  a real divergence cannot be silently laundered. Done in Gerrit 2734.
- [x] Tests prove `_check_normalization` detects both `schema_version` changes
  and `normalization.library_only_params` changes between live data and the
  manifest. Done in Gerrit 2734.

## Testing

Run `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" pytest tests/unit/test_mcp_library_parity.py`
and the pre-push `make verify` gate from the ticket worktree.
